repos.name: Donchitos/Claude-Code-Game-Studios
repos.description: Turn Claude Code into a full game dev studio — 49 AI agents, 72 workflow skills, and a complete coordination system mirroring real studio hierarchy.
repos.one_liner: A sophisticated multi-agent orchestration framework that transforms Claude Code into a hierarchical game development studio.
bullets: Built on a shell-based coordination system managing 49 specialized AI agents.
Implements a hierarchical studio structure with 72 distinct workflow skills.
Designed for complex, multi-step project execution and automated software engineering.
Demonstrates advanced agentic workflows for large-scale code generation and project management.

repos.name: gitroomhq/postiz-app
repos.description: 📨 The ultimate agentic social media scheduling tool 🤖
repos.one_liner: An agentic social media scheduling platform designed to automate content distribution across multiple channels.
bullets: Full-stack TypeScript application utilizing modern web frameworks for high-performance scheduling.
Integrates agentic workflows to automate content creation, optimization, and posting schedules.
Provides a centralized dashboard for managing cross-platform social media presence.
Useful for marketing teams and developers looking to automate brand engagement via AI.

repos.name: Orkas-AI/Orkas
repos.description: Orkas is an open-source (MIT), local-first AI team for your desktop: a Commander turns your goal into to-dos and coordinates 16 built-in specialist agents plus Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw and Hermes, with projects, scheduled automations and connectors. Free app for macOS & Windows; built-in models or your own keys.
repos.one_liner: A local-first AI team for desktop environments that coordinates multiple specialist agents to execute complex goals.
bullets: Local-first architecture ensuring data privacy and reduced latency for desktop tasks.
Features a Commander module that decomposes high-level goals into actionable to-do lists.
Integrates 16 built-in specialist agents alongside support for Claude Code and other models.
Ideal for power users needing an autonomous agentic assistant for local file and system operations.

repos.name: ryoiki-tokuiten/Deepthink
repos.description: Using LLMs for iteratively exploring the solution search space at scale.
repos.one_liner: A TypeScript-based framework for using LLMs to iteratively explore and optimize solution search spaces at scale.
bullets: Leverages iterative reasoning loops to refine outputs beyond standard single-pass generation.
Focuses on systematic exploration of complex problem spaces using LLM-driven heuristics.
Scalable architecture suitable for research, data analysis, and complex decision-making tasks.
Applicable for quant-style research where iterative validation of hypotheses is required.

repos.name: CopilotKit/OpenDuet
repos.description: An Open Source template for a proactive AI agent that gets your work done and keeps you in the loop.
repos.one_liner: An open-source template for building proactive AI agents that maintain context and execute tasks autonomously.
bullets: TypeScript-based template designed for rapid deployment of proactive agentic systems.
Focuses on 'human-in-the-loop' interaction patterns to ensure agent alignment and transparency.
Provides a structured framework for state management and task execution in agentic workflows.
Useful for developers building enterprise-grade AI assistants that require persistent context.
